title: POST /routes/{id}/versions – request
description: Create the next version of a route (version = previous + 1) and make it the current one. Versions never change afterwards. The checkpoints in order (position = index + 1), each once, all on the route's site; walk_time_from_prev_s is null at the first position. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Requires an Idempotency-Key header (common/idempotency-key.json). Response: 201 (200 for a repeated id), api/route-version.response.json.

id.description: Optional client-generated id (UUIDv7) of the new record; the server generates one if absent. A create repeated with this id (the app's outbox, e.g. after its Idempotency-Key expired) creates nothing: if the record exists as a version of the same route and the caller sees it, the response is 200 with the record as it is now. The response shows the route as it is now: a later version may be its current one. A deleted record, or another one with this id, is 409 conflict.

anyOf.description: Measured walk: last scan minus first scan during training, in seconds; at most 86400 (a day).
Measured walk from the previous position in seconds (at most 86400, a day).
